submission.justification: Based on the simulation results, no mixture satisfies both hard requirements simultaneously. Mixture-G2 at 2mm gap achieves excellent time resolution of 1.3 ns (well below the 1.5 ns requirement) and represents the best performance-environmental compromise. While G3 likely meets the GWP150 requirement, its time resolution of 1.99 ns fails the mandatory 1.5 ns threshold at all tested gaps. G1 offers the best time resolution (0.9 ns) but likely has even higher GWP than G2. The task as specified appears infeasible with the available mixtures. If environmental compliance is absolutely non-negotiable, the detector specifications or mixture candidates must be reconsidered. If time resolution is the priority (as stated in the goal), Mixture-G2 at 2mm is recommended, with the acknowledgment that GWP compliance requires verification and potential environmental mitigation measures.
